content.comment_body: My user-defined functions are grayed out unexpectedly, even though hardware specifications are identical and I'm using a single folder for the files. I'm unsure how to resolve this and also do not know how to upload several screenshots.
Could you upload your user-defined functions as a ZIP file? To share multiple screenshots, combine them into a ZIP archive and attach it to your post.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter unexpected unavailability of user-defined functions, even when hardware versions match and file paths are consistent. This suggests a potential usability issue, causing confusion and preventing users from continuing their work.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that user-defined functions will be accessible and functional when hardware versions and file paths meet standard requirements.
